_comment: v1.16.4 - De Coniuratione Catilinae 38, 51.1-8, 51.20-31, 52.7-12, 52.19-23. sall.1 bare digits: start ON the digit. The speeches of Caesar (51) and Cato (52) open paragraphs with an unclosed quote (51.1, 51.25, 52.7, 52.19): fix removes them. Boundaries that differ from Perseus, page followed: 38.3 (page at Namque, Perseus at post), 51.26 (page at ceterum, Perseus at Illis). 51.20-31 rather than the planned 20-29, so the Thirty Tyrants example ends where Caesar ends it.
